verdict.rationale: LiteLLM documents a unified `completion()` interface and an OpenAI-compatible proxy API. A maintainer confirms streaming and function-calling work the same as with the openai-python SDK. The docs also cover REST endpoints such as `/mcp-rest/tools/list` and `/mcp-rest/tools/call`, callable with curl, plus JSON-driven team, key and budget management on the proxy. Missing for 10: a published OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all probed paths returned 404), explicit reference docs for the admin/management API endpoints (only implied by JSON payload examples), and independent hands-on corroboration of driving the full product via API.
